newsitem.title: USA: Lott sees progress in tax, budget talks.
newsitem.headline: Lott sees progress in tax, budget talks.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott, a Republican from Mississippi, said talks on the budget and tax bills were "making really good progress."
Lott's assessment was very different from a much more negative appraisal from Senate Democratic Leader Thomas Daschle of South Dakota.
"I think we're making really good progress," Lott told reporters. "Tom needs to cheer up," he said of Daschle.

He said meetings between the House and Senate, which went on through the weekend, would continue this week, and that the White House was having input. "We understand where their (administration) hot spots are and we're trying to make sure they understand ours."
Lott said he still aims to finish work on the tax and spending bills before Congress' recess starting in early August.
